verdict.rationale: gstack's own docs show two install scopes: the upgrade skill 'detects global vs vendored install', and host docs say project-local setup never silently replaces a global install. That confirms both scopes exist, but the evidence only implies them. Missing for 10: documented install commands or flags for choosing each scope, explicit guidance that project-local files are committed with the repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: Detects global vs vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.
Project-local setup never silently replaces a global install.
